purpose: Original background images for the login page; no embedded UI or text.

prompts.name: airport
prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: production background photograph for a refined Chinese business travel assistant login website. Generate a single landscape 16:10 photograph, ideally 1920x1200 or larger. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, UI, forms, buttons, watermarks, logos, artificial gradient overlays or mockup frames. A real scene, natural architectural/editorial photography, realistic proportions and subtle material detail, premium but not ostentatious. Consistent restrained color grade across the travel series: warm ivory highlights, soft blue-grey daylight, muted green and charcoal, moderate saturation, avoid heavy yellow/orange. The website will overlay text at bottom-left and a pale form wash over right 38%, so keep important travel subjects in left/central 60% and right side relatively calm. Compose a compelling, clearly travel-related scene, not a generic abstract backdrop. Scene: looking out through a vast contemporary airport terminal window at early morning. A clearly recognizable unbranded passenger airplane at its gate in left-middle distance, slim dark vertical window mullions, soft peach-blue horizon beyond apron, natural morning sunlight on pale stone interior floor in foreground and a modest row of empty charcoal terminal chairs cropped at far left. Aircraft small enough to see architecture and spaciousness, large enough immediately recognizable. The photograph fills the entire image; no fake blur fade. Quiet sense of anticipation and departure.
